svg.title: Forest and coastal states of West Africa
svg.desc: Map of the Gulf of Guinea coast with the centres of major forest and coastal states: Asante (capital Kumasi) in present-day Ghana; Dahomey (capital Abomey) in present-day Benin; Oyo (capital Oyo-Ile, Old Oyo) and the sacred city of Ile-Ife in Yorubaland; and the Benin Kingdom (capital Benin City) in present-day Nigeria. Positions are approximate.
